entries.0154d87e8984338b: This business manufactures and sells aluminum sheet and extruded shapes made by extrusion. Nippon Light Metal Company, Nikkeikin Act, Nikkei Katazai, Riken Keikinzoku Kogyo and Toyo Rikagaku Kenkyusho, as well as Nikkei Siam Aluminium in Thailand, carry out this business. Electronic materials such as electrode foil for aluminum electrolytic capacitors also fall under this category. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥111,219 million (up 7.4% from the prior year), the fourth largest of its kind. The company explains that sheet materials for lithium-ion battery cases performed well, while demand for semiconductor manufacturing equipment stagnated.

entries.5f8cb44bf73ffcb0: This business manufactures and sells aluminum raw materials, chemicals, and aluminum ingots and alloys, and is the segment with the largest revenue in the group. The business handles alumina, aluminum hydroxide, various chemicals, aluminum alloys and others. The main entities responsible are Nippon Light Metal Company, Ltd., Nippon Denkyoku and Nikkei MC Aluminum, and Nikkei MC Aluminum also has subsidiaries overseas (India, Thailand, China and the United States). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥183,583 million (up 10.9% year on year). The company explains that sales were strong for heat-dissipating flame-retardant filler applications using aluminum hydroxide and alumina, and for secondary alloys for automobiles in the United States.
entries.6d30ca4b11c249b8: Transport-related products (truck body installation and others)
entries.8f3a5e664ecdc31f: This business manufactures aluminum-based industrial components, landscape products, panels for refrigerators and freezers, and transport-related products such as trucks, and also provides services such as transportation and information processing.
entries.9aa7ad2c85956571: This business manufactures aluminum-based industrial components, landscape products, panels for refrigerators and freezers, and transport-related products such as trucks, and also provides services such as transportation and information processing. Nippon Furuhāfu, which installs truck bodies; Nikkeikin ALMO, which makes automotive parts; Nikkei Paneru Shisutemu, which makes refrigeration panels; Nikkei Enjiniaringu, which handles landscape products; and Nikkei Butsuryū, which handles transportation and warehousing, are responsible for this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥177,660 million (up 3.1% year on year), second in size. The company explains that the result exceeded the previous fiscal year due to effects such as price revisions for truck body installation.
entries.a0e32937960aa215: The group holding company of a comprehensive aluminum manufacturer that handles everything from aluminum ingots and chemicals to sheets, extrusions, fabricated products, foil and powder.
entries.ca01011fbfc07201: This business covers aluminum foil and powder (powder and paste). The main operators are Toyo Aluminium and subsidiaries in China, the United States, India, France and other countries. Foil is used for lithium-ion battery exterior casings and pharmaceutical packaging materials, powder is used for heat dissipation in electronic materials, and paste is used for automotive paints, among other applications. It also handles household goods such as household aluminum foil and aluminum containers. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥113,011 million (up 3.8% from the prior year), the third largest of its kind.
